source: Owner direct chat after glazing was deferred
owner_message_english_translation: I have a few comments: I see that the columns now have one gloss and the walls another, but I like the appearance of the columns. Also, this is tile: on the floor it is visible as tile, but the columns and walls look like continuous material. It would be better to make large-format tile.
decision: Use the current accepted column stone response as the gloss reference for walls. Add a readable large-format stone slab layout with thin joints to columns and walls. Preserve the existing mineral character and floor; glazing remains deferred.
supersedes: Review01 R2's requirement to retain a quieter broad-wall gloss than the current column gloss
The existing binding-only preservation restriction for four accepted stone components, solely to apply the requested slab variants
preservation: Accepted stone texture, material and native Painter source bytes remain immutable. New material variants may reuse them read-only. Accepted floor/strip and metal bindings, ceiling, current glazing/support, geometry, transforms, collision, gameplay, lights and exposure remain unchanged.
implementation_scope: Native Unreal material graphs for slab joints and projection; no geometry production or new texture pixels are required. The user's material-layout instruction does not require a new architectural concept gate.
module_decision: The controller asked an optional orientation/module preference. Any eventual default must be identified as the controller's working choice, not exact owner approval.
acceptance_status: Direction and implementation authorized; resulting slab material bytes remain subject to fresh independent review and owner viewing. No final atmosphere acceptance.
